name: Lumkile Mondi
bio: Lumkile Mondi is a senior lecturer at the School of Economic and Business Sciences of the University of the Witwatersrand in Johannesburg. He is a Trustee of FinMark Trust. He worked extensively in the African continent during his tenure at the Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) as an executive for eleven years and is a director of Gemfields Group Limited and Thelo Rolling Stock Leasing.
